data.title: Rising yields are quietly crashing the stock market’s earlier winners of 2026
data.summary_raw: Surging Treasury yields have begun to hammer parts of the stock market that might easily be overlooked, especially with the spotlight once again shining brightly on a small group of glamorous tech companies.

data.title: Higher yields are taking their toll on all areas of the stock market, except the one that matters
data.summary_raw: Technology is the only one of the S&P 500’s 11 sectors that gained since Sept. 1, as Treasury yields have climbed to multi-decade highs.

data.title: Options traders are betting on a dramatic drop in interest rates
data.summary_raw: Recent options activity points to bullish positioning for long-term bonds and utilities.

data.title: Fed’s minutes show no appetite for a series of interest-rate hikes
data.summary_raw: September’s rate hike was viewed by many officials as needed just in case inflation remains sticky.
